scope: Complete chapter 5, MTP-S000636–MTP-S001051; terminology author support for independent QC. Records cover provisional technical uses and non-obvious grammatical applications; ordinary function words and repeated unproblematic canonical terms are not separately inventoried.
policy: Records group actual source loci, not token counts. Exact spans retain source bytes. Comparison entries are semantically reviewed commitments, not automatic substring matches or approvals. All provisional uses remain proposed; canonical glossary is unchanged.
